mapper.update: UPDATE HOSPITAL H SET STATUS = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST HUR WHERE HUR.HOSPITAL_ID = H.HOSPITAL_ID AND HUR.REQUEST_TYPE = 'TEMP_CLOSE' AND HUR.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND HUR.TEMP_CLOSE_START_AT <= LOCALTIMESTAMP AND HUR.TEMP_CLOSE_END_AT > LOCALTIMESTAMP) THEN 'TEMP_CLOSED' ELSE 'OPEN' END WHERE H.HOSPITAL_ID = #{hospitalId} AND H.STATUS IN('OPEN','TEMP_CLOSED')

UPDATE HOSPITAL H SET STATUS = 'TEMP_CLOSED' WHERE H.STATUS = 'OPEN' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST HUR WHERE HUR.HOSPITAL_ID = H.HOSPITAL_ID AND HUR.REQUEST_TYPE = 'TEMP_CLOSE' AND HUR.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND HUR.TEMP_CLOSE_START_AT <= LOCALTIMESTAMP AND HUR.TEMP_CLOSE_END_AT > LOCALTIMESTAMP)

UPDATE HOSPITAL H SET STATUS = 'OPEN' WHERE H.STATUS = 'TEMP_CLOSED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST HUR WHERE HUR.HOSPITAL_ID = H.HOSPITAL_ID AND HUR.REQUEST_TYPE = 'TEMP_CLOSE' AND HUR.STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND HUR.TEMP_CLOSE_START_AT <= LOCALTIMESTAMP AND HUR.TEMP_CLOSE_END_AT > LOCALTIMESTAMP)
